item.title: Florida city cancels St. Patrick's Day parade, citing new anti-DEI law
item.description: A new Florida law that prohibits taxpayer dollars from going toward diversity initiatives has prompted Delray Beach to cancel its St. Patrick's Day parade after a nearly 60-year run.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: US has lost measles elimination status, global health authorities say
item.description: The U.S. has lost its status as a country where measles is eliminated, according to researchers with direct knowledge of the deliberations at the Pan American Health Organization.

item.title: SpaceX successfully catches Starship and makes history
item.description: The company's spacecraft returned to its Texas launchpad in dramatic fashion — by carefully lowering itself until two metal arms attached to the launch tower could secure it.

item.title: Bomb found near ethanol plant in central Illinois forces evacuations
item.description: The bomb was discovered Friday afternoon at the BioUrja Renewables plant in Peoria. Officials say the bomb has been "rendered safe," but called it a "credible threat." The FBI is investigating.

item.title: Alaska voters aren't ditching ranked choice voting, top-four primaries
item.description: This is the second time Alaskans voted down an effort to repeal the state's unique election system, which voters first approved in 2020. A repeal effort in 2024 also failed narrowly.
